obligations.requirement: Common normalized input carries Down/Move/Up/Cancel phase and deterministic pointer lifecycle.
obligations.oracle: Unit and replay traces cover Down->Move*->Up|Cancel, predicted samples cannot create ownership transitions.
obligations.acceptance: Equivalent traces produce identical ownership transitions; invalid terminal ordering is rejected.

obligations.requirement: PositionOnly input supports multi-pointer routing and two-finger pan/pinch without pressure/contact geometry/tool metadata.
obligations.oracle: Capability-masked two-pointer corpus with pressure/contact geometry unavailable.
obligations.acceptance: Viewport claim and pan/pinch succeed; unsupported optional capability does not fail core gesture.

obligations.requirement: AutoIntent is the runtime/product default when no explicit policy is configured.
obligations.oracle: Default-construction test plus platform-host integration smoke.
obligations.acceptance: All common/platform entry paths resolve default policy as AutoIntent.

obligations.requirement: AutoIntent/GesturePriority draw activation is spatial and sample-rate independent.
obligations.oracle: Equivalent geometric paths at low/high sample rates plus sub-slop jitter.
obligations.acceptance: Equivalent paths yield same activation result; jitter remains Pending; sample count alone never locks Ink.

obligations.requirement: Pending provisional Ink/Preview can be cancelled into viewport gesture with zero canonical mutation.
obligations.oracle: Pending A provisional samples then B Down; compare operation count/document digest before and after cancellation.
obligations.acceptance: Provisional state is removed, no canonical operation occurs, A+B atomically become viewport-owned.

obligations.requirement: MultiInk creates isolated independent Ink sessions and disables automatic pinch.
obligations.acceptance: 2/4 independent sessions, isolated cancel/up behavior, zero viewport gesture activation.

obligations.requirement: GesturePriority ignores a late second contact after first Ink lock without disturbing the first stroke.
obligations.oracle: A activates Ink; B Down/Move/Up|Cancel; continue A.
obligations.acceptance: A remains same Ink session and commits normally; B creates no Ink/Viewport session and has zero effect on A.

obligations.oracle: Inject claim conflict on one member.
obligations.acceptance: No partial viewport ownership remains after failed group claim.

obligations.requirement: Windows/Android/Web report facts and phases but do not implement divergent second-pointer semantics.
obligations.acceptance: Generic-contact second-pointer decision is owned by common coordinator on all three hosts.

obligations.requirement: Accepted G4/G4.4 PointerKey, multi-stroke, Arc keyed preview and canonical ordered-commit behavior remains valid.
obligations.oracle: Existing relevant G4/G4.4 CTest suites and scope diff audit.
obligations.acceptance: All frozen regressions pass with no semantic schema/ObjectKind/Operation change.

obligations.requirement: Corrective build and targeted scenarios are packaged for one exact-revision physical qualification.
obligations.oracle: Qualification manifest validates revision, build identity, policy scenarios and capability profile.
obligations.acceptance: Bundle is reviewer-resolvable and status is READY_FOR_CORRECTIVE_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION; no Gate PASS is claimed.
